verdict.rationale: Ollama ships a REST API for running and managing models, a shell install script, and (per community reports) ROCm containers. Users also report running it as a long-lived server on Linux, where the GUI app was not available, which implies headless operation. However, no first-party doc explicitly describes headless or daemon mode or CI-pipeline usage, and one user complains that server configuration is hidden behind defaults. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of headless/daemon (serve) operation, documented official container images, CI-pipeline usage guidance, and exposed server configuration controls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines
